title: patient.proxy.changed.v1
description: A patient downgraded or revoked a caregiver's proxy access, or the clinic revoked it on the patient's verified request (IDC-013); subject = the patient_proxies row. Opaque patient references only. Consumers drop the proxy from dual-delivery lists (status revoked) or limit messages to logistics (scope BOOK_ONLY) and refresh the caregiver's picker; record reads never cache the scope.

proxyRef.description: The caregiver's opaque patient reference (the one the Edge uses).

version.description: Outbox id of this event: monotonic per aggregate.
